# authwise_scim_connections (Data Source)

A connection an upstream directory (Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace, OneLogin, JumpCloud) pushes a realm's users and groups through, over SCIM 2.0. Give the directory `base_url` and the secret of an `authwise_scim_token` for this connection. `base_url` is empty until the issuer has a host.

`provider_id` names the realm's federated provider that pushed users sign in through: each user's identifier is written under it, taken from `identifier_attribute` (`userName`, the default; `externalId`; or `emails.primary`). Without it the connection keeps profiles only, a directory mirror. `on_delete` is what the directory's delete does: `deactivate` (the default) or `delete`. `status = "disabled"` refuses every request and keeps the tokens. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `realm_id` (String) Parent identifier `realm_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `scim_connections` (Attributes List) Every scim_connection under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scim_connections))

<a id="nestedatt--scim_connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scim_connections`

Read-Only:

- `base_url` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `identifier_attribute` (String)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `on_delete` (String)
- `provider_id` (String)
- `scim_connection_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `status` (String)
